patch_resolves_note: The staged patch changes the cleanup condition from `if (needs_free)` to `if (*needs_free)` at the ASan-reported root site in `frame_get_lazychunk()`. Stage 04 fixed-side validation uses runtime evidence from the instrumented fixed build rather than trusting the commit message.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The error-cleanup branch truth must come from `*needs_free`, not from the non-null pointer parameter `needs_free`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the `if (needs_free)` cleanup site, the branch predicate must agree with the ownership flag `*needs_free` before `free(*chunk)` can run.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the vulnerable original, the caller-supplied `needs_free` pointer is non-null so the branch truth is 1 even though `*needs_free` is still 0 on the in-memory parse-error path. The fixed original evaluates the same cleanup state with the branch truth taken from `*needs_free`, so the required predicate is satisfied at the root site.

nodes.state: At the cleanup guard, the pending free candidate is still the in-memory frame slice `frame->cframe + header_len + offset`, not a lazy chunk allocated by `frame_get_lazychunk()`.
The ASan sink `free(*chunk)` consumes that same interior frame pointer as its free argument.

edges.relation: The exact `*chunk` value pending at the erroneous cleanup guard is forwarded unchanged into the `free(*chunk)` sink on the next line.
